title: RepoRecord
description: One repository the company owns or plans. The registry MAPS repos; it never copies them — `url` points at the source of truth on GitHub. `repo` (owner/name) is the unique key.

repo.description: owner/name — the stable unique key across the registry

role.description: 'unknown' = inventoried from GitHub metadata, not yet classified from contents

last_activity.description: ISO date of last GitHub activity (drives the age-based status)

stripe_mode.description: billing surface; the publish+charge gate guards any flip to live

sku.description: linked SKU id (e.g. sku_001); null for non-product repos
